title: Adana: Elena Ruxandra Bertea vs Lucrezia Stefanini — Elena Ruxandra Bertea
rules:
This market refers to the tennis match between Elena Ruxandra Bertea and Lucrezia Stefanini in the Adana, originally scheduled for September 28, 2026 at 6:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Elena Ruxandra Bertea' if Elena Ruxandra Bertea advances against Lucrezia Stefanini.

This market will resolve to 'Lucrezia Stefanini' if Lucrezia Stefanini advances against Elena Ruxandra Bertea.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by October 12, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the WTA Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
